title: Fantasy League
subtitle: Pick a squad from a real AFC event and score points from what they actually do.
headline: Free Fire Fantasy League
blurb: We are building a fantasy league that runs alongside AFC events. It is not live yet. If you would play it, tick the box below and we will know it is worth finishing.
how.pick.title: Pick your squad
how.pick.body: Choose players from the teams in a real AFC event, before the first match starts.
how.score.title: They play, you score
how.score.body: Your squad earns points from what those players actually do in their matches, kills and wins included.
how.win.title: Climb the table
how.win.body: Everyone who entered that event is on one table. Highest score at the end takes it.
